name: megascenes-collage-maker
description: Make a collage from 2 to 14 photos in your MegaScenes library, arranged in the layout and style you describe.

interface.longDescription:
Pick from 2 to 14 photos in your MegaScenes library and describe the collage: a grid, a scrapbook page, a polaroid wall, a birthday board or a travel poster. The photos are arranged into one composition in that style.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the collage needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The collage opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For birthdays, trips, mood boards and social posts.

Limitations: the photos are redrawn into one image, so small details can differ from the originals. Photos must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Arrange 2 to 14 photos into one collage
Return the collage in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a polaroid collage from my last 6 MegaScenes photos
Create a birthday collage with my latest photos
Arrange my recent trip photos into a travel poster

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a polaroid collage from my last 6 MegaScenes photos. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one collage with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a collage here?
positive.expected_behavior: The collage models with their settings and how many photos each takes. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a polaroid collage from my last 6 MegaScenes photos. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my collage on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my collage to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
